_about: What the stub's reader says (V1-PLAN / PLAN-IPAD-NOTES I8): `lines` are the texts it gives to the numbered lines of a sheet, in order — line 1 first — each with the confidence it states; `picture` is what it says of a photographed page, one text per line. Invented for the tests: no real call was made to write this file, and the words are nobody's handwriting. Read by the core tests and by the e2e stub (e2e/servers.mjs) alike.
